Ivy: FYI I'm opening a PR to replace multiple tiny console snippets with a single composable example that shows heatmap generation, tracehook stitching, and cost breakdown usage. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13002
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 13002 created by Ivy. Auto-lint running.
Ethan: I'll own the JS/Node example and add tests for the bucket translation logic.
Maya: I'll rewrite the dashboard copy so the new example reads well in the Console quickstart flow. Also add a short note about p90/p99 changes.
Ravi: I'll do the Go snippet and call out header reconciliation for `trace_key` vs `x-rd-trace`. Also include base64 vs hex decode hint.
Ivy: Quick sample for header fallback (pseudo): `trace = headers["trace_key"] || headers["x-rd-trace"] || infer_from_span()`
Ethan: JS snippet pushed:
```js
// prefer new header, fall back to legacy
const traceKey = req.headers['trace_key'] || req.headers['x-rd-trace'];
const decoded = tryBase64Decode(traceKey) || tryHexDecode(traceKey);
```
Maya: UX nit: emphasize that latency panels now break out "routing" and "decode" times; old dashboards that used `latency_ms` should sum those two. Added mapping note.
Ravi: Go snippet (short):
```go
raw := headers.Get("trace_key")
if raw == "" { raw = headers.Get("x-rd-trace") }
decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(raw)
if err != nil { decoded, err = hex.DecodeString(raw) }
```
DocsBot: docs-bot: link-check initiated. Scanning 11 pages. Found 1 redirect and 0 errors.
Ivy: Plan: merge after CI and link-check green, then post a short migration blurb in #release-notes. Targeting Tue morning.
Ethan: Added unit tests and a small comment explaining the bucket scaling factor. PTAL.
Maya: LGTM on copy. Ravi, can you add a one-paragraph Dedicated customer billing note?
Ravi: Done. Mentioned expected small spike for a week due to increased bucket resolution and how to opt into legacy mapping.
Ivy: Thanks everyone — I'll squash+merge once CI finishes. DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed.
